live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-24, after the verysmall tier's gate was read and passed (borg-zoo#749; borg-reborn-rs #1147, PR #1148). Two arms on track-p 85f8800b (normal world): off (caution_walk_away_immobile 0, the play before #1147) and ship (1, shipped). Tier small-rest (RULES 14) of the study on the same build and arms: classes-1800 starts 46-90, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, evidence not retained, disjoint from the pilot (classes-18) and the verysmall tier (starts 1-45) and the later tiers.
Progress endpoint (Rule 22, #758): CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, with deaths, unfinished outcomes and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; dungeon depth (DL3/DL5) and level arrival as diagnostics.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (an arm that plays wa0's keys was not exercised). Report per arm against wa0: the CL5 endpoint, deaths and causes (walk-away: mushroom patches, jellies, floating eye, other), rescued and newly killed (exact McNemar), DL3 and DL5 reached, stalls and bouncing-borg exits, and from the notes of ship the #1147 counts (steps with and without a clean way to the stairs, staircase leaves, cornered cures, cornered Phase Door, last-resort blows). Descriptive (RULES 14).
